references.text: The place that the Lord your God will choose to put his name there - this is a central theme in Deuteronomy regarding the place of worship.
Describes the situation when the place the Lord chooses is too far away, the same theme as in 14:24.
The preceding verse that introduces the context about tithes and the place the Lord chooses for his name.
The continuation explaining the solution when the way is too long - to exchange the tithe for money.
The place that the Lord your God will choose to put his name there - repetition of the formula concerning the chosen place.
The place that the Lord your God will choose to put his name there - the same expression regarding the place of worship.
The Lord's blessing upon the people - related to the phrase 'when the Lord your God blesses you'.
Solomon's prayer at the temple dedication refers to the place where God's name shall dwell.
